verdict.rationale: Unity's scripting API, AssetDatabase, and command-line/batch-mode automation (unity-docs-6/7/8/11/12) allow developers to write editor scripts that iterate over many assets or objects programmatically, which supports bulk operations, but there is no dedicated 'bulk operations' feature or AI-native tooling for it documented. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/batch-apply feature, AI-agent-driven bulk workflows, and independent hands-on evidence of performing bulk operations at scale.
